title: Literature check: thermals heredity looks new (nearest: Takagi & Kaneko's differentiating spots); c53's fed vortex dipoles are a variant of drifting condensate dipoles, with zombie vortices as prior art for vortex replication; Marangoni boats explain why field-only Marangoni flames cannot swim
summary: Four sources opened (abstract pages). Takagi & Kaneko 2001 is the nearest work to heredity in replicating spots but has no inheritance test or selection, so the established thermals selection result appears new. Parfenyev 2023 describes a forcing-made dipole drifting through a periodic box, and Marcus et al. 2013 self-replicating zombie vortices in stratified shear; c53's fed dipoles are a variant with a consumable gain. Ender & Kierfeld 2021 show Marangoni self-propulsion needs a body distinct from its emitted surfactant and a Peclet threshold, which explains c51's reactive-Marangoni negative and suggests a field-boat world.
